obligations.statement: The product must be capable of being folded into a compact configuration with reduced footprint.
derivation_premises: Folding requires relative motion of parts to achieve a compact shape.

obligations.statement: All components must remain physically attached to the product during and after folding.
derivation_premises: Detached parts would violate the requirement of no loose pieces.

obligations.statement: The product must be openable by a user through a logical sequence of manual actions.
derivation_premises: A logical sequence implies that the kinematic degrees of freedom allow an intuitive ordering.

obligations.statement: When open, the legs must be spread apart in different directions to provide a usable footprint.
derivation_premises: Legs must rotate or translate to move apart.

obligations.statement: The product must remain in an open configuration without external support.
derivation_premises: A mechanism must prevent unintended collapse or movement.

obligations.statement: The product must resist accidental folding or movement during use.
derivation_premises: A locking mechanism must require deliberate action to release.

obligations.statement: The product must fold back to its original compact shape after deliberate release.
derivation_premises: Folding must be repeatable to the same configuration.

obligations.statement: The product must support a small object during work.
derivation_premises: The stand must withstand the weight of the object without collapsing.

obligations.statement: The product must be manufacturable and assemblable in a logical order.
derivation_premises: A product must be buildable with available processes.

obligations.statement: The product must remain intact during normal opening and folding cycles.
derivation_premises: Repeated use must not cause fatigue or failure.

obligations.statement: The product must have at least one degree of freedom to allow folding.
The product must have a mechanism to lock or hold the open position.
derivation_premises: Staying open without support requires a latching or friction hold.

obligations.statement: The product must allow deliberate release before folding.
derivation_premises: A release mechanism must be user-operable.

obligations.statement: The product must be operable without tools or external equipment.
derivation_premises: Manual operation must be possible without tools.

obligations.statement: The product must have a stable base when open on a desk.
derivation_premises: The stand must not tip over under load.

candidates.summary: Three legs connected by revolute joints to a central hub, with a detent or snap lock to hold open.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Primary function is mobility; analysis route available.

candidates.summary: Three legs using compliant flexures to fold and a friction hold to stay open.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Compliant mechanism requires compliance analysis; route not available.

candidates.summary: Three legs using prismatic joints to slide out and a detent to lock.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Prismatic joints provide mobility; analysis available.

assumptions.statement: The desk surface is assumed to be flat and stable.
assumptions.why: The scenario environment is 'desk' and the stand will be used on it.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: Evidence that the desk surface is uneven or unstable.

assumptions.statement: The user is assumed to have two hands available for operation.
assumptions.why: The requirement says 'by hand', implying manual operation.
